2981-5034-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2981-5034-5660-6769.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sol Ring, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

225-1308-4094-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-1308-4094-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3129-4772-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-2457-5434-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1368-2033-4359-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-4359-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

206-222-527-997.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-997.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3861-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3861-4231-6753.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and has at least two +1/+1 counters on it

2335-4613-7347.description:
Activate Solarion by tapping it, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Solarion using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Solarion.
Repeat.

2921-4559-5272-6757.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2921-4559-5272-6757.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3991-5987-6798.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

647-1563-3899-4365.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2034-2048-2146-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Cloud Key.
Repeat.

1429-5402-5929-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1491-2313-5268-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2060-5200-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
2060-5200-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler
Activate Crystalline Crawler five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {5}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.
2060-5200-6602.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5042-5256-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5042-5256-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4320-4871-5544.description:
Activate Martyr's Cause by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting any opponent.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers when Forsaken Miner dies, and Forsaken Miner triggers when you commit the crime in step 1.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Forsaken Miner trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Martyr's Cause ability from step 1.
Repeat.
4320-4871-5544.notes: You can repeat this loop whenever you or a permanent you control would be dealt damage to prevent that damage.

645-1267-3908-5231.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-3908-5231.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

428-1694-3604-5541.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
428-1694-3604-5541.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Ghyrson Starn enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghyrson Starn with haste.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3388-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Moritte of the Frost and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3388-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Moritte of the Frost and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Moritte of the Frost to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

957-2556-2665.notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Mnemonic Wall.
957-2556-2665.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the token Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1379-1543-3656-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Karn Liberated has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
1379-1543-3656-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn Liberated.
Activate Karn Liberated by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1467-2104-2397-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-2104-2397-3634.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

565-1283-2450-4600.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {3}, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens using their second abilities, or target any other permanent.

259-2963-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Halo-Charged Skaab.
When Halo-Charged Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to mill two cards and put Time Warp on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next durn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.
